goals.instruction_template: Reproduce the exact source passage as written.
not_this: It does not teach the model to summarize, explain, or answer questions about the documents.
It does not shorten, rewrite, or paraphrase anything.
goals.plain_language: Teach the model the exact wording of my documents so it can reproduce them as written.
goals.required_source_evidence: At least one cleaned passage of text recovered from the document.
goals.supervision_boundary: There is no separate context. The whole passage is the target and every part of it is trained on.
goals.target_construction: Each cleaned passage is copied exactly as the training target; nothing is added, removed, or reordered.
goals.title: Learn the text itself
goals.what_the_model_learns: To reproduce the retained source passages as written. The whole passage is the training signal; nothing is held back as a question or prompt.
goals.what_you_provide: Documents whose cleaned text you want the model to learn. Nothing else is needed.

goals.instruction_template: Continue the passage with its exact source remainder.
not_this: It does not invent new endings; the target is always the real remainder from the source.
It is not a summary, an answer, or a rewrite.
goals.plain_language: Teach the model to keep writing a passage from a given starting point, in the document's own words.
goals.required_source_evidence: A cleaned passage of at least two characters, so it can be split into an opening and a remainder.
goals.supervision_boundary: The opening is context; the remainder is the target and is the only part trained on.
goals.target_construction: The passage is split part-way through its characters (half by default); the opening becomes the context and the exact remainder becomes the target.
goals.title: Continue a passage
goals.what_the_model_learns: Given the opening part of a real source passage, produce the exact remainder of that same passage.
goals.what_you_provide: Documents with passages long enough to split into an opening and a remainder.

goals.instruction_template: Produce the exact source section body for this heading.
not_this: It does not generate a body for a heading that has none in the source.
It does not summarize, outline, or reorder sections.
goals.plain_language: Teach the model to write out a section's body when given that section's heading.
goals.required_source_evidence: A real heading followed by body text beneath it in the recovered document structure.
goals.supervision_boundary: The heading is context; the section body is the target and is the only part trained on.
goals.target_construction: The exact heading text becomes the context and the exact body text beneath it becomes the target.
goals.title: Recover a section from its heading
goals.what_the_model_learns: Given an exact heading from the source, produce the exact section body beneath it.
goals.what_you_provide: Documents with real headings and the text under them: Markdown, HTML, or Word documents with heading structure. PDF recovery supplies only per-page labels, not real headings.

goals.instruction_template: Apply the recorded cleaning change to this exact source text.
not_this: It does not teach general editing, rewriting, or style transfer beyond the recorded deterministic change.
It is not translation or summarization.
goals.plain_language: Teach the model to apply a change that was actually recorded during cleaning, by showing the text before and after it.
goals.required_source_evidence: At least one cleaning rule that recorded a before-and-after change in which the text actually changed and neither side is empty.
goals.supervision_boundary: The text before the change is context; the text after the change is the target and is the only part trained on.
goals.target_construction: The text before the recorded change becomes the context and the exact text after that change becomes the target.
goals.title: Reproduce a recorded change
goals.what_the_model_learns: Given the text exactly as it was before one recorded cleaning change, produce the text exactly as it was after that change.
goals.what_you_provide: Documents cleaned with rules that recorded at least one before-and-after change. Source-code files are never edited by cleaning, so they cannot supply one.

goals.instruction_template: Produce the exact structural attribute recorded by this source.
not_this: It does not extract record fields, names, dates, or any value from the prose; only attributes that the recovered document structure explicitly records.
It does not infer, guess, or compute values that are not explicitly present in the source.
It is not question answering over the document.
goals.plain_language: Teach the model to state one structural fact that the document's formatting explicitly records, such as a heading's level or a link's address.
goals.required_source_evidence: A recovered document element whose formatting records a supported attribute, together with the passage that covers it.
goals.supervision_boundary: The covering passage is context; the single attribute value is the target and is the only part trained on.
goals.target_construction: The passage covering the element becomes the context and the attribute's exact recorded value becomes the target.
goals.title: Extract a structural attribute
goals.what_the_model_learns: Given the source context, emit exactly one attribute recorded during recovery: a heading level, a code block's language, a link or image address or title attribute, a math display flag, a citation key or locator, whether a list is ordered or an item is checked, or a table column alignment.
goals.what_you_provide: Documents with recoverable formatting, such as Markdown, HTML, or Word documents, or source-code files whose language is recorded. Plain text, PDF, JSON, and CSV sources record none of these attributes and yield nothing for this goal.

goals.instruction_template: Emit the provided label for this context.
not_this: It does not invent labels from the context text.
It does not train or score a classifier.
It is not a shortening, rewriting, or question task.
goals.plain_language: Teach the model to emit the exact label you already supplied for each context. The compiler copies those labels; it does not guess them.
goals.required_source_evidence: Imported rows that already contain a non-empty context, a non-empty operator-supplied label, and a non-empty annotator identity.
goals.supervision_boundary: The context is not the target. Only the operator-supplied label is trained on. The annotator identity is leakage metadata copied from the row.
goals.target_construction: The imported context, label, and annotator strings are copied exactly; no label is invented.
goals.title: Classify with provided labels
goals.what_the_model_learns: To emit the exact label the operator supplied for each context. The compiler does not invent, guess, or score labels.
goals.what_you_provide: JSONL, JSON, or CSV rows that already contain a context, a label, and an annotator identity.

representations.plain_language: The passage itself is the training example. Every part of it is trained on.
representations.title: Whole text

representations.plain_language: A starting context taken from the source, followed by the exact source text that should come next. Only the completion is trained on.
representations.supervised_region: The completion only; the prompt is context.
representations.title: Prompt and completion

representations.plain_language: A short instruction you supply, the exact source context as input, and the exact source-derived output. Only the output is trained on, and the instruction must describe the real task.
representations.supervised_region: The output only; the instruction and input are context.
representations.title: Instruction and output

representations.plain_language: A two-turn conversation: the user turn is the exact source context and the assistant turn is the exact source-derived target. Only the assistant turn is trained on.
representations.supervised_region: The assistant turn only; the user turn is context.
representations.title: Conversation

representations.plain_language: A context string, the exact label the operator supplied, and the annotator who supplied it. Only the label is trained on.
representations.supervised_region: The provided label only; context and annotator are not the target.
representations.title: Context and label
